title: SPEAK YOUR MIND: THE SPEECH CONTINUATION TASK AS A PROBE OF VOICE-BASED MODEL BIAS

bias_targets.methodology: Transcribing speech continuations from male and female voice prompts using ASR, and using an LLM judge to evaluate the text on social bias dimensions such as agency/competence, emotionalisation (affect framing), and appearance/objectification.

Measuring and comparing glottal source parameters (H1-H2, H1-A3, and CPPS) between input speech prompts and generated continuations to evaluate whether models preserve or disproportionately suppress non-modal phonation types (e.g., breathy, creaky, end-creak).
